name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
text: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

fr.name: Mobius le Monarque de Glace

pt.name: Mebius, o Monarca Frio como o Gelo
